figures.finding: The Cayman Islands Film Commission's rebate pays at least 15% of a production's Cayman qualifying spend, from CI$250,000 of it, with uplifts for unscripted, Cayman-set, positive-portrayal, training and Sister Islands work to at most 35% (Guidelines 2025).

value.name: Cayman Islands Film Production Rebate Programme

figures.applies: Cayman Islands, productions starting principal photography on or after 18 January 2024.

sources.said: Minimum CIQPE thresholds: • CI$250,000 across all eligible production categories. … The Rebate is calculated as a minimum of 15% of CIQPE. … the maximum Rebate for any individual CIQPE is capped at 35%.
The rebate rate goes from 15 - 35%, depending on the type of production and whether it is eligible for certain uplifts.
